_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DLCo5F2y7fgbM8tstGoyyUn)_

Fixes #38012

Clause-②: no

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：读规格源码和对外文档的作者看到的说法与实际一致；运行行为无任何变化。
- 为什么做：智能体规格清理的收尾，修正上一轮审核记下的两处小说法（源码注释里一个早已并入删除的转换被说成「仍在链上」，文档补半句编译期报错说明）。
- 出错会怎样：只改一段注释和文档表格两格，出错也只是措辞不准，可随时直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes
- **`packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts`, the note where `AIKnowledgeSchema` used to live.** It said the protocol-17 `agent-knowledge-topics-to-sources` conversion "remains in the chain". It does not: the rename was absorbed before release into the removal of the whole `agent.knowledge` block (the ABSORBED note at `conversions/entries/17/sharing-rule-access-level-full-to-edit.ts:17`), no registry or entry module carries the id, and `retired-after.census.json` has no row for it. The sentence now says exactly that. Comment only: no schema, type or export changes.
- **`content/docs/ai/agents.mdx`, the `tools` and `knowledge` rows.** Each gains a half-clause: a `defineAgent({ … })` literal that sets the removed key fails `tsc` as an excess property (TS2353), beside the existing parse refusal. `defineAgent` takes `z.input` of the strict `AgentSchema`, a closed object type. The old by-name `never` refusal is not claimed.
- **One changeset**, `@objectstack/spec` patch (spec publishes `src/**/*.zod.ts`), carrying both declaration lines.

## Tests
All readings at head `c5a5d51901`, worktree from `origin/main` `8b47659e8e`.

<details><summary>Type check of the new docs claim (throwaway probe against the rebuilt spec dist)</summary>

A scratch file outside the repo, compiled with tsc 6.0.3 (`--ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --skipLibCheck`) against `packages/spec/dist/index.js` after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` (VERDICT command-exit 0):

- control `defineAgent({ name, label, role, instructions })`: no diagnostic;
- the same literal plus `tools: [...]`: `error TS2353: Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'tools' does not exist in type ...`;
- the same literal plus `knowledge: { topics: [...] }`: `error TS2353: ... and 'knowledge' does not exist in type ...`.

No existing type test pins this. The probe file was not committed.
</details>
